title: Physically accurate OpenFOAM case generation for dam-break flow with an obstacle (FoamBench damBreakWithObstacle)

task_sources.name: CFDLLMBench FoamBench Basic damBreakWithObstacle cases and evaluation scripts, BSD-3-Clause

metric.description: Physical success rate over all 10 FoamBench Basic damBreakWithObstacle tasks: the fraction whose submitted OpenFOAM case runs successfully within its time limit and has NMSE < 0.1 against the reference solution. NMSE uses the original CFDLLMBench implementation. Missing or failed cases count as 0; the denominator is 10. Higher is better.

baseline.name: Foam-Agent with gpt-6-luna, max_loop=15, OpenFOAM v10
